rows.grounds: locative plural indicating the sphere in which the action is recognized
ablative of cause; compound sṛṣṭi-karaṇa denoting the act of creating
agent noun denoting the one who performs creation
proper name of the deity identified with the creative role
quotative particle marking the designation or title

items.question: On what basis is Brahma proclaimed the creator in the worlds?
premises: Creation takes place within the worlds.
Brahma performs the act of creation.
A title is assigned according to one's causal role.
items.inference: Therefore Brahma is proclaimed the creator because of causing creation in the worlds.
items.plain_english: Because he brings about creation in the worlds, Brahma is proclaimed as the creator.
